voice: You have a GPU cluster ready for inference.
Do you want to run Dynamo or NVIDIA NIM?
Start with the same cluster target.
Choose Dynamo or NIM as the platform.
AICR resolves a recipe with the component versions and settings for that choice, then turns it into a bundle.
Apply the bundle for your chosen platform with your deployment tool.
AICR checks the installed stack against the recipe saved in that bundle.
The Dynamo example uses a DynamoGraphDeployment. With NIM, create a NIMService.
Send a test request to the endpoint you chose.
